C2 passes F-1 with 7 min extra holding leaving 1880 kg against the 1800 kg reserve, and it is the lowest-cost option at 943.32 USD with 0 missed connections versus 988.32 USD for C3. I am offering PILOT_EXTRA_HOLDING to unlock C2, and C3 is also acceptable on the same concession.

C2 passes G-2 on B7 with the 10 min buffer and G-3, and its total cost of 943.32 USD is the lowest with zero missed connections and zero overtime. I offer GROUND_REASSIGN_CREW to clear C-1 for C2, since C3 costs 988.32 USD with 30 min overtime and no ground concession is needed for C-1 there.
